camel_example: aliyun live UpdateLiveDelayConfig --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --Stream liveStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'example.com' --DelayTime 60
description_en: Updates the live stream delay configuration
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-delay-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain example.com --app liveApp0000 --stream liveStream0000 --delay-time 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveDelayConfig

parameters.help_en: The AppName of the live stream. You can specify an asterisk (*) to match all AppNames under the domain name
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称。支持通配符*，代表该域名下所有的AppName
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. You can use the wildcard (*) to specify all StreamNames under the AppName
parameters.help_zh: 直播流流名称。支持通配符*，代表该AppName下所有的StreamName
parameters.name: stream

parameters.help_en: The duration for which the playback is delayed. The value must be an integer. Valid values: 16 to 3600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 直播流延迟播放的时长，仅支持整数。取值：16~3600。单位：秒
parameters.name: delay_time

parameters.help_en:
The trigger mode for the task. Valid values:

PUBLISH_ONLY: Stream delay is triggered only by relevant parameters in the ingest URL.

CONFIG_ONLY: Stream delay is triggered only by the configuration. Parameters in the ingest URL are ignored.

PUBLISH_CONFIG: Stream delay is triggered by both the configuration and parameters in the ingest URL. Parameters in the ingest URL have a higher priority than the configuration
parameters.help_zh:
任务触发模式，取值：

PUBLISH_ONLY ：仅支持带延播推流参数触发。

CONFIG_ONLY ：仅支持配置触发，推流参数无效。

PUBLISH_CONFIG ：同时支持推流和配置，并且推流参数高优于配置
parameters.name: task_trigger_mode
